max_bytes.description: Maximum YAML bytes to parse. Defaults to policy.max_output_bytes.

max_depth.description: Maximum nested YAML depth to convert. Defaults to 128.

max_documents.description: Maximum YAML documents to return. Defaults to 50.

path.description: Project-relative or in-project absolute YAML file path.

project_id.description: Stable project id returned by project.list.
